title: ai chat: a record_draft card opens a prefilled new-record form (values via router state, marked AI 建议, never auto-submitted)
body:
Filing gate ③: a task on the maintainer's word. Sam, on the objectstack#27286 re-evaluation (doc https://claude.ai/artifact/DLzVUSyDabAxTDuwAp7a97, §5 phase 1): 「同意开发 S1 粘贴即建单」 (2026-10-30 12:53Z), then 「其实不只是粘贴吧，任何内容我都可以让他创建和更新记录是吗？通过聊天的方式。」 (12:54Z), choosing to fold in update (phase 1b). Scope: AI drafts in chat, a person saves; no spec contract; no in-form button (phase 2), no S2, no S3. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

cloud 那一半（cloud#3383）让 AI 在聊天里返回 `record_draft`：一份已经在服务端校验过的新记录草稿。这张卡做界面：聊天里显示一张卡片「新建 X（已预填 N 个字段）→」，点开跳到新建表单，字段已预填并标「AI 建议」，由用户检查后自己保存，绝不自动提交。预填值通过路由 state 传递，不放查询串，因为里面可能有联系人隐私。

## Facts (objectstack main)

- `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot` already renders the `open_record` hand-off (`recordHandoff` tests, `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`).
- `RecordFormPage` (app-shell) reads explicit prefill from the query string today.

## Work

1. plugin-chatbot: parse a `status:'record_draft'` tool result and render the card with the object label and the field count. Show `dropped` reasons in a collapsed detail.
2. Clicking it navigates to the object's `/new` with the values in **router state**, never the query string.
3. RecordFormPage: read router-state values as create values. An explicit query-string prefill wins over them. Mark each AI-filled field 「AI 建议」 until the user edits it. Never auto-submit. A reload drops the draft, which is acceptable; say so in the PR.
4. Tests: card rendering, the navigation carries state with no query string, precedence, the marker, no auto-submit. Include an ablation.

## Done when

A record_draft from chat opens a prefilled, marked, unsaved new-record form.

Depends on: objectstack-ai/cloud#3383 for the producer. The UI can build against the documented result shape.
